kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (hndʾm /⁠handām⁠/, “member, limb”) or Persian هندام (handâm). Compare Persian اندام (andâm).
g: a kind of simple machine doubling the physical power of a man
